title: Liability for pre-incorporation transactions.
bodyText: All persons purporting to act as or on behalf of a corporation, knowing there was no incorporation under this chapter, are jointly and severally liable for all liabilities created while so acting.
bodyHtml: [§414-34]  Liability for pre-incorporation transactions.  All persons purporting to act as or on behalf of a corporation, knowing there was no incorporation under this chapter, are jointly and severally liable for all liabilities created while so acting. [L 2000, c 244, pt of §1]
